about_tagline.message: Lock out distractions. Lock in to your best self.

about_sentence.message:
RelockIn is the browser that kills distractions. From the Focus Hub, you can easily set up rules and schedules to limit your usage of distracting apps and websites. It works on a simple principle: what if every minute you spent on your phone was intentional?

In addition, RelockIn includes a fully customizable privacy-sensitive mobile browser. RelockIn never tracks your searches, and RelockIn never shares your data with anyone. Because RelockIn is the only focus app that includes a fully integrated browser, it is the only app that lets you customize websites to remove distracting features like Reels and Shorts, offering you an advanced layer of control.

Locks any URL that contains this text. Use * as a wildcard for anything in between.

- reddit.com/r/politics locks just that subreddit
- x.com/*/status/* locks individual tweets without locking the rest of X, e.g. profile pages

typingSentences_long2.message: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit. - Will Durant

typingSentences_long3.message: Your choices become your habits. Your habits become your character. And your character becomes your destiny.

typingSentences_paragraph1.message: Doomscrolling or doomsurfing is the act of spending an excessive amount of time watching short-form content or watching large quantities of user-generated content or news, particularly negative news, on the web and social media. Surveys and studies suggest doomscrolling is predominant among youth. In 2019, a study by the National Academy of Sciences found that doomscrolling can be linked to a decline in mental and physical health.

typingSentences_paragraph2.message: Infinite scrolling is a design approach which loads content continuously as the user scrolls down, thus eliminating the need for pagination. Consequently, this feature can exacerbate doomscrolling as it removes natural stopping points at which a user might pause. Research has also demonstrated that the tendency of social media platforms to amplify negative content may worsen this continuous scrolling behaviour, leading users to remain engaged with unfavourable news for extended durations.

typingSentences_paragraph3.message: The business models of most social media platforms rely heavily on user engagement, which means that the longer people stay on their platforms, the more advertisements they see, and the more data is collected on their behavior. This creates a cycle where emotionally charged content - often involving negative or anxiety-inducing information - is repeatedly pushed to users, encouraging them to keep scrolling and consuming more content.

typingSentences_paragraph4.message: Instant entertainment, information, and connectivity make social media appealing. Social media addiction is characterized by excessive and compulsive usage that affects daily functioning and overall well-being. It encompasses more than just spending an excessive amount of time online; it involves compulsively checking for updates, feeling anxious when offline, and suffering from negative impacts on real-life relationships and responsibilities.

typingSentences_paragraph5.message: Short form content algorithms are intensely addictive because they remove your choices and intention from the equation. By removing the cognitive burden of deciding what's next, apps replace conscious decision-making with a seamless, passive flow state on autopilot. In this flow state, it's incredibly easy and rewarding to continue and incredibly difficult to quit.

typingSentences_paragraph6.message: Social media is addictive by design. Tech companies engineer these apps to capture your attention by triggering the brain's reward center. The combination of dopamine-driven approval, unpredictable rewards, and psychological hooks makes putting your phone down incredibly difficult. Recognizing these design tactics is the first step toward regaining control over your digital habits and fostering a healthier relationship with technology.
